title: Chiropractic Adjustment
description: Controlled, targeted movement applied to a joint to restore mobility and ease stiffness.
whatItIs: A chiropractic adjustment is a controlled, targeted movement applied to a joint of the spine or another area of the body.
howItWorks: The adjustment briefly moves the joint through a specific range, helping restore movement in areas that are stiff or restricted. It also provides sensory input to the nervous system through the receptors located in and around the joint.
howItHelps: It may help improve joint mobility, reduce stiffness and make everyday movement feel easier and more comfortable.
